meta.name: vercel-composition-patterns
meta.description: React composition patterns that scale. Use when refactoring components with boolean prop proliferation, building flexible component libraries, or designing reusable APIs. Triggers on tasks involving compound components, render props, context providers, or component architecture. Includes React 19 API changes.

copy.tagline: 用组合模式重构组件，消除布尔属性泛滥
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构组件或设计可复用的组件库
copy.tagline_en: Refactor components with composition patterns to eliminate boolean prop proliferation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring components or designing reusable component libraries

howto.what: Claude 会依据这套 React 组合模式规则，在重构组件时避免新增布尔型开关，改用复合组件、状态提升等方式，并参考 React 19 的新 API 写法。
howto.when: 当你要求重构 React 组件、设计组件库 API，或处理复合组件等任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我重构这个组件，把布尔开关改成复合组件。
say.note: Claude 会应用规则中的复合组件模式。

say.text: 按规则设计一个可复用的组件库 API。
say.note: Claude 会遵循架构规则设计接口。

say.text: 检查我的组件架构，避免布尔 prop 滥用。
say.note: Claude 会对照规则审查代码。

howto.what_en: Claude will follow React composition patterns: avoid boolean props, use compound components and state lifting, and apply React 19 API changes when refactoring or building components.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to refactor React components, design component library APIs, or address tasks involving compound components, render props, context providers, or component architecture.

say_en.text: Refactor this component to use compound components instead of boolean switches.
say_en.note: Claude applies the compound component pattern.

say_en.text: Design a reusable component library API following the rules.
Review my component architecture for boolean prop misuse.
